notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result, "saros" (id 997551, released 2026-04-30, Housemarque, published by Sony Interactive Entertainment), is the right game. No StrategyWiki page under "Saros" or "SAROS". saros.fandom.com answers the API under "SAROS" (redirected from "Saros"), with only 8 linked pages: "Arjun Devraj", "Carcosa", "Echelon IV", "Eclipse", "Passage", "Weapons", "Category:Characters" and "Category:Enemies"; names only were looked at, nothing copied, and the chapters follow those names plus RAWG's short description (a Soltari Enforcer on a lost colony under an eclipse). What "Passage" and "Echelon IV" are is not stated in the data; they are treated as place names only as a guess. No Steam app, so steam is None and there are no achievements; PlayStation trophies were not available from the allowed sources. The chapter list is thin and should be revisited once the wiki grows.
